question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher kept stopping her online lesson ______ to check if her students were following it.
solution:
The correct answer is **'occasionally.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Occasionally **means *at infrequent or irregular intervals; now and then, periodically, intermittently, sporadically, spasmodically.*

 
 
• **Example: **Quwesh very **occasionally **goes to the bar for celebration.
 
 
 
• With the reference to the context of the sentence, we see that the *teacher is concerned about whether students are listening to her online lesson or not so that's why she kept stopping her lesson periodically or at irregular intervals, the best-fit word for this is **occasionally**. Here, all the three options indifferently, imparity, unresponsibly are negative words for a teacher who is concerned about her students whether they were following the lesson or not.*

Hence,** option 1) occasionally** is the correct answer.

**Complete Sentence**__

The teacher kept stopping her online lesson __**occasionally**__** **to check if her students were following it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Indifferently **means *having no particular interest or sympathy; unconcerned, mediocre, neither good nor bad, average, ordinary, aloof, callous.*
 
• **Impartially **means *in a way that does not show support for any of the sides involved in an argument*
 
• **Unresponsibly **means *not responsible or accountable to any other person or thing; careless, reckless, incautious, heedless, imprudent.*
